response.original_title: I Left Something In The Woods
response.overview: The human figures chase one another and dissolve into each other in a continuous pursuit lacking a narrative resolution, generating a temporal loop in which the future folds back on the past, contaminating places inhabited by ghosts. The monochromatic images alternate with recurring crystalline structures, inspired by the first photographs of snowflakes taken by Wilson Bentley, which heighten the relationship between capture and disappearance, interruption and repetition of fragile, temporary forms.
